data.name: Oyinka
data.gender_notes: Oyinka is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Yoruba language, Oyinka means 'God's treasure'. This name reflects the belief that every child is a precious gift from God. The name Oyinka carries the meaning “God's treasure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Oyinka usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine gift of life and the importance of cherishing and honoring it.
data.etymology: Oyinka belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oyinka total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
